t: A free geographic information system for advanced map and terrain analysis.
steps: Download GRASS GIS from the project site.
Choose the installer for Windows, macOS, or Linux, or use Docker or conda.
Ask IT to approve the install on each computer.
Read the First time users guide.
Load a small sample map and try a terrain tool.
Compare it with QGIS and pick one tool for the class.
Test one lesson on a single computer first.
